_comment: Authoritative numbering maps for epistaeon benchmark structures and published substitution sites. PDB chain offset_to_uniprot applies ONLY to the named structure protein. Model indices are alignment columns, not UniProt positions. The SWS1 benchmark uses a separate explicit source-site -> historical-human-CDS -> alignment-column map; 1U19 is only its bovine homolog template. Source-numbering exceptions override ancestral offsets. Deleted S212 has no modern residue; source211 is alignment-ambiguous. scripts/numbering.py checks modern chain offsets and the SWS1 map.

2HHB.reason: initiator Met cleaved in the mature globin

1MBO.reason: initiator Met cleaved in the mature myoglobin

human_equivalent.toga2_check: MB alignment row HLphyCat2 (Physeter macrocephalus) has no indels relative to hg38
human_equivalent.note: Same numbering scheme as human myoglobin. human (and TOGA2 hg38) residue n = 1MBO author residue n-1. Verified by scripts/numbering.py.

A.role: bovine rod opsin, SWS1 homolog template

B.role: bovine rod opsin, SWS1 homolog template

1U19.reason: 1:1; but an ACE acetyl cap occupies author position 0 and must be skipped when iterating residues
1U19.benchmark_use: Homologous geometric template for SWS1, as in Yokoyama2014; NOT an assayed SWS1 structure. Paper site labels use bovine rhodopsin numbering; human SWS1/CDS and alignment coordinates require the explicit sws1_benchmark map.

A.note: Full-length NR3C1 numbering. Ortlund/Bridgham source positions map Y27R->558, L29M->560, F98I->629, Q105L->636, S106P->637, L111Q->642. Deleted ancestral S212 has NO modern homolog; do not map it to Asp742. The source211/212 boundary needs curated alignment. Chain B is a PGC1a coactivator peptide, not GR.

Offsets refer to original AncCR source numbering, not a universal map for each PDB author sequence. Apply source-numbering exceptions first. Positions-2/-1/0 are expression tags; 1..210 use+531, 213 onward+530. Deleted source S212 has no modern homolog. An unconstrained alignment instead gaps Q211 and pairs S212 with Asp742; resolve this boundary from the original source alignment before assigning211. AncGR2/3GN8 author numbering shifts after the deletion and must be mapped separately.
